Requirements TRU-01 and TRU-02 ensure that only authenticated members can borrow or return books and that all transactions are logged for auditability. These requirements collectively ensure a secure and trustworthy system.

requirements.text: The system shall ensure user authentication for borrowing and returning books.
The system shall log all transactions for auditability and accountability.
The system shall ensure data protection through encryption of member data.
The system shall provide an accessible interface for all users.
The system shall enforce a maximum of 5 books per member to prevent over-borrowing.
The system shall automatically notify members of overdue books via digital means.
The system shall maintain real-time inventory status of all books.
The system shall provide a backup mechanism to recover all transaction data.
The system shall allow librarians to revoke borrowing privileges for members with overdue books.
The system shall enable searching for books with a response time of under 2 seconds for 95% of queries.
The system shall process book returns within 1 second to maintain high throughput.
The system shall maintain an uptime of 99.5% to ensure consistent availability for users.
The library management system shall minimize energy consumption through energy-efficient practices.
The system shall provide an energy usage report for library operations at least quarterly.
The library management system shall implement a recycling program for damaged books.
The system shall provide an annual report on usage statistics to ensure transparency.
